author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000124558 (PTHR11140)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Prp8 (FBgn0033688) and orthologs

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

This node adds "contributes_to second spliceosomal transesterification activity" to members of [PRE-MRNA SPLICING FACTOR PRP8 (PTHR11140)](http://www.pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR11140), based on a single annotation to (YEAST|SGD=S000001208|UniProtKB=P33334).

But Prp8 is a scaffold protein within the spliceosome, and this contributes_to catalytic activity annotation is not appropriate. (E.g. UniProt summary for human PRP8 (Q6P2Q9) says "Functions as a scaffold that mediates the ordered assembly of spliceosomal proteins and snRNAs. Required for the assembly of the U4/U6-U5 tri-snRNP complex, a building block of the spliceosome. Functions as a scaffold that positions spliceosomal U2, U5 and U6 snRNAs at splice sites on pre-mRNA substrates, so that splicing can occur. Interacts with both the 5' and the 3' splice site"

So I think this MF should be removed (and maybe replaced with a new annotation to the new GO:0140378 ! protein complex scaffold activity term?)
title: PAINT issue: PTN000124558 (PTHR11140)

author: marcfeuermann
body:
I've removed the wrong annotation. 
I asked for the creation of the new **GO:0140378 - protein complex scaffold activity term** to avoid accumulating **adaptor** terms, otherwise in five years we will have the same problem we have with **binding** terms. I plan to review all the corresponding annotations to distinguish between real adaptors and regulators, scaffolds, structural constituents, ...
This project will be launched once the the scaffold term will be available for PAINTing. It is not yet the case. I keep this ticket open...
I'm glad everyone's  talking about this term and likes it ;-)
It will be really helpful.
Marc.

author: marcfeuermann
body: Finally, the new term could be PAINTed.
